text:
Matt Boldy is the shooter on the Wild's top unit, and this month he has been very good at it. He has 14 goals and 29 points in 25 games, 99 shots, and goals in three straight games heading into the week, four in all. His 13.4 expected goals say the finishing is honest: 14 goals is almost exactly what his shots earned.

Where the luck shows up is around him. The Wild have scored 9.8 more goals than their chances deserve with Boldy on the ice, and that is padding his points. Playing beside Kirill Kaprizov during a hot run helps, and it won't stay this kind. The underlying play stays good: Minnesota gets 57% of the expected goals at five on five with him out there.

He is a power forward with a top-10% shot, carries the puck in more often than he dumps it, and draws more penalties than he takes. He also took time this week to say Joel Eriksson Ek doesn't get enough credit. We project about 93 points.
headline: Boldy is shooting his way through the streak
